scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1021 DXF writes containing a LIGHTLIST, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One LIGHTLIST with two named LIGHT references, an ACAD_LIGHT dictionary pointer, one persistent reactor and an object owner, emitted as AC1021 ASCII and Binary using explicit source-handle remaps. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and check destination bytes, caller fields, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed readback of ordered light names and remapped owner/reactor/light handles.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 97 and Binary 96 allocation offsets injected; caller/destination/identity rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated writer transaction evidence for one AC1021 profile does not establish independent source-profile semantics or producer interoperability.
The test does not emit or verify ACAD_LIGHT named-dictionary membership and does not qualify native light behavior.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G public-writer inventory with another exact uncovered variable-size route or overload, keeping generated transaction evidence separate from source and consumer qualification.
